topic: Pay yourself first: move savings out on payday, before you spend.

episode.title: Pay Yourself First

shots.narration: Does your payday money disappear before you save?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D modern cafe, empty clear savings jar beside an empty coin tray, no text or signs.
shots.action: Kash tips the empty coin tray toward herself.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, puzzled expression, warm pastel lighting.

shots.narration: Let's rewind: payday arrives, and spending looks tempting.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same cafe table, ten plain gold money tokens on a tray beside an empty savings jar and a coffee cup, no markings.
shots.action: Kash reaches toward the coffee cup.

shots.narration: [excited] Coin's idea: move savings out first, before spending.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright cafe tabletop with ten plain money tokens, an empty clear jar and a coffee cup, no text.
shots.action: Coin slides the empty savings jar in front of Kash.
shots.mood: Coin beams brightly while Kash watches with curious eyes.

shots.narration: Here's an example: ten coins arrive on payday.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clean cafe tabletop, ten plain gold money tokens arranged separately on a tray, empty clear jar nearby, no text.
shots.action: Coin presents the ten tokens with outstretched arms.
shots.mood: Clear, cheerful demonstration with bright soft lighting.

shots.narration: In this example, two go straight into savings.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cafe table with ten plain gold money tokens and an empty clear savings jar, no markings or text.
shots.action: Coin drops two tokens into the savings jar.
shots.mood: Satisfying golden sparkle, Kash's attentive smile.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Now spending comes after saving, not before.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cafe table, two tokens inside a clear savings jar, eight remaining on a tray beside a coffee cup, no text.
shots.action: Kash draws the tray of remaining tokens toward the coffee cup.
shots.mood: Relaxed smile, friendly warm cafe lighting.

shots.narration: Those example savings already have their own place.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of a clear jar holding two plain gold tokens, coffee cup softly blurred behind it, no text.
shots.action: Coin points at the two saved tokens.
shots.mood: Proud cheerful grin, clean golden highlights.

shots.narration: That's paying yourself first: savings before spending.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright cafe table with savings jar, remaining-token tray, coffee cup and Kash's small blank notebook, no text.
shots.action: Kash opens her blank notebook beside the savings jar.
shots.mood: Confident smile, calm and practical atmosphere.

shots.narration: [excited] Today, draw your savings jar; next, let's build a payday routine.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of a blank notebook beside the clear savings jar in the bright cafe, no letters, numbers or captions.
shots.action: Kash draws a simple jar outline in her notebook.

episode.endHook: Next episode: turn your savings move into a simple payday routine.
episode.description: Kash nearly spends her payday money before saving any. Coin demonstrates paying yourself first: moving savings out on payday, before spending, using a simple example.
